name: Burnline
tagline: A satellite tracking simulator, physics straight from the textbooks.
facts: Every propagation cross-checked against Vallado's own code: 1 m position, 1 mm/s velocity
Maneuver planner: Hohmann, bi-elliptic, plane change, phasing, checked against the book's printed delta-v
NumPy mirror of every engine function held to the C++ at 1e-9
SGP4 compiled to WebAssembly so it runs in the browser
Unreal at real-world 1:1 scale: one unit is one centimetre
status: Co-built with a friend: always say we/our, never my/I built, and credit the friend. Live at orbit-simulation.vercel.app. The C++ engine and the verification gate run in CI. The Unreal plugin is written but has never been compiled, so the Unreal side is a design, not a running build.

shots.wide: whole Earth, the catalog around it, auto-orbit (establishing)
shots.globe-iss: globe flies to Tianhe (CSS), orbit line and swath draw. NOT the ISS
shots.globe-chase: behind a spacecraft model, coverage cone under it
shots.mission: LEO to GEO Hohmann flown at 3000x, orbit plane visible
shots.modes: chase in night vision, thermal and CRT modes
shots.catalog: catalog search typed, one result picked
shots.inspector: inspector sheet scrolled through a satellite's facts
shots.follow: camera locked on Hubble over the night side, Florida city lights
shots.satview: from on board Hubble, tilted to the horizon, slow pan
shots.chase-hst: riding behind the Hubble model at 10x
shots.orbit-close: auto-orbit close in, MetOp-B's orbit ring and footprint crossing
shots.rise: slow rise off Aqua out to the whole Earth
shots.planechange: plane change flown from the chase camera
shots.bielliptic: bi-elliptic transfer, out past the target and back
